why_it_fails: It asks whether tonight's update worked, which the agent can check itself; there is nothing for a person to decide.

card.title: Did tonight's update work?
card.context: Every night at 2 am the app installs the newest version of our booking software on the clinic computers. Last night was the first run after we moved it to the new server.
card.question: Does tonight's update work?

choices.label: No, it is broken
choices.cons: someone has to look into it

card.why: It probably worked, but I wanted to be sure.
